ValidationRule.description: Mandatory fields for all Marketing Child Statuses except Completed Status based on CurrencyIsoCode Fields: Region Target Audience Expected Revenue in Campaign Expected Incremental Revenue
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Marketing_Child", OR(ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "KHR"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "IDR"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "USD"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "KRW"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "MYR"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "PGK"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "PHP"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "SGD"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "BHD"), ISPICKVAL( CurrencyIsoCode, "VND")), OR( ISBLANK (TEXT ( Region__c )), ISBLANK ( Target_Audience__c ), ISBLANK( ExpectedRevenue ), ISBLANK( Expected_Incremental_Revenue__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill up all fields: Region, Target Audience, Expected Revenue in Campaign, Expected Incremental Revenue
